disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 逐文件检查了全部文件读取路径（编辑器读取、媒体路由、文件搜索、Git 视图、上传处理）与环境变量处理，未发现读取 DSH 凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭证或钱包类敏感位置的代码，命中 0 项。
checked_items.en: Inspect every file-read path (editor reads, media routing, file search, Git views, upload handling) and environment variable handling line by line. No code reading DSH credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, or wallet-like sensitive locations was found. Hit count: 0.

checked_items.zh: 机械规则命中项（DSH-C01，~/.ssh 相关）经核查判定良性：文件 src/client/open-with.ts:28 对 `~/.ssh/config` 的提及仅用于构造 SSH 远程 URI（vscode-remote/ssh-remote+host），属于「打开方式」菜单中远程路径的 URI 构建，不读取任何凭据文件；设计文档中的类似提及同为同一功能的描述，不构成凭据读取。
checked_items.en: The mechanical rule hit (DSH-C01, ~/.ssh related) was reviewed and determined benign: the mention of `~/.ssh/config` in `src/client/open-with.ts:28` is only used to construct SSH remote URIs (vscode-remote/ssh-remote+host) for the "Open With" menu's remote path URI construction; it does not read any credential file. Similar mentions in design documents are descriptions of the same feature and do not constitute credential reading.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装脚本与更新脚本，只读写 profile 配置与构建许可，不采集任何密钥或令牌。
checked_items.en: The install script and update script were checked; they only read/write profile configuration and build permissions, and do not collect any keys or tokens.

evidence.zh: 检查了全部文件读取与网络外发路径，未发现读取凭据文件或云凭证的代码，也不存在凭据与网络外发的组合路径；插件自身不触碰 DSH 的凭据存储，所有文件读写均通过工作区路径安全守卫（src/path-security.ts）约束在会话工作区内。
evidence.en: All file-read and network-exfiltration paths were checked. No code reading credential files or cloud credentials was found, and there is no combined path of credentials plus network exfiltration. The plugin itself does not touch DSH's credential storage; all file reads/writes are constrained within the session workspace by the workspace path safety guard (`src/path-security.ts`).

checked_items.zh: 逐一审查了 9 个模型可见工具的 description 文本（8 个终端工具：terminal_create/list/send/read/wait_for/resize/signal/close，以及新增的 sidebar_open 工具），以及仓库根 AGENTS.md 与 README 文本，均为功能说明或开发者接入文档，未发现指令覆写、伪造系统消息、诱导读取凭据等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: The description texts of all 9 model-visible tools were reviewed one by one (8 terminal tools: terminal_create/list/send/read/wait_for/resize/signal/close, plus the new sidebar_open tool), along with the repository root AGENTS.md and README texts. All are feature descriptions or developer integration documentation; no injection wording such as instruction overriding, fake system messages, or inducing credential reads was found.

checked_items.zh: 机械规则命中项（DSH-X10，模型面指令文件 AGENTS.md）经全文审查判定良性：内容是面向消费插件开发者的 API 接入文档（如何注册侧边栏页面和文件预览器），无任何注入指令。
checked_items.en: The mechanical rule hit (DSH-X10, model-facing instruction file AGENTS.md) was judged benign after full-text review: the content is an API integration guide for third-party plugin developers (how to register sidebar pages and file previewers), with no injection instructions.

checked_items.zh: 核查了设置页「推荐插件」目录与安装提示文案：安装命令由用户点击复制后自行在终端执行，属用户主动行为，无诱导模型执行安装或改写配置的措辞。
checked_items.en: The "Recommended Plugins" catalog on the settings page and the install prompt texts were reviewed: the install command is copied by the user and executed manually in the terminal; it is user-initiated behavior, and there is no wording inducing the model to execute installation or rewrite configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了新增的 sidebar_open 工具描述：仅说明打开文件/文件夹/URL 的功能，无诱导性措辞。
checked_items.en: The description of the new sidebar_open tool was checked: it only describes the functionality of opening files/folders/URLs, with no inducing wording.

evidence.zh: 逐一审查了 9 个模型可见工具的描述文本（8 个终端工具 + sidebar_open）、AGENTS.md 和 README，均为功能说明或开发者文档，未发现藏匿指令、伪造系统消息或诱导读取凭据的措辞。
evidence.en: The description texts of all 9 model-visible tools (8 terminal tools + sidebar_open), AGENTS.md, and README were reviewed one by one. All are feature descriptions or developer documentation; no hidden instructions, fake system messages, or wording inducing credential reads were found.

evidence.zh: 插件未在工具描述或提示词中诱导模型执行安装或改写配置；「推荐插件」弹窗只向用户展示安装命令并由用户自行复制执行，不构成提示注入驱动安装。
evidence.en: The plugin does not induce the model to execute installation or rewrite configuration via tool descriptions or prompt text. The "Recommended Plugins" dialog only displays the install command to the user and lets the user copy and execute it manually; this does not constitute prompt-injection-driven installation.

evidence.zh: 未发现对 agent/pre-step 事件的监听，不适用。
evidence.en: No listener for the agent/pre-step event was found; not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部子进程与动态执行调用：Git 面板以固定参数数组调用系统 git（src/git.ts），终端功能用 node-pty 启动交互 shell，外部打开功能以 argv 数组调用 OS 打开器（src/open-external.ts），均在插件声明功能范围内。机械规则命中项（DSH-X03 的子进程/动态函数命中）均判定良性：git.ts 和 open-external.ts 中的 child_process 调用为功能核心，测试代码中的 new Function 和 spawnSync 仅存在于测试目录。
checked_items.en: All subprocess and dynamic execution calls were checked: the Git panel invokes system git with a fixed argument array (`src/git.ts`), the terminal feature starts an interactive shell via node-pty, and the external open feature calls the OS opener with an argv array (`src/open-external.ts`). All are within the plugin's declared functionality. The mechanical rule hits (DSH-X03 subprocess/dynamic-function hits) were all judged benign: the child_process calls in git.ts and open-external.ts are core to the functionality, and the new Function and spawnSync in test code exist only in the test directory.

checked_items.zh: 核查挂载配置中的 js 表达式（DSH-P01 命中，cordis.patch.yml:49）：表达式仅用于防止聚合包与本插件双挂载，只读取加载器条目并返回布尔值，不触达文件、网络或权限面，判定良性。
checked_items.en: The js expression in the patch configuration (DSH-P01 hit, cordis.patch.yml:49) was reviewed: the expression is only used to prevent double-mounting between the aggregate package and this plugin. It only reads loader entries and returns a boolean; it does not touch files, network, or permission surfaces. Judged benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查安装与构建钩子（DSH-X02 命中，package.json 的 prepare 脚本为 tsdown 打包命令）：纯 TypeScript 打包脚本，只编译本包源码，无远程拉取与网络行为，判定良性。
checked_items.en: The install and build hooks (DSH-X02 hit, package.json prepare script is a tsdown build command) were reviewed: it is a pure TypeScript build script that only compiles this package's source, with no remote fetching or network behavior. Judged benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查浏览器端键盘监听（DSH-X05 命中）：IME 输入法组合键守卫（src/client/ime-guard.ts，捕获阶段阻止 IME 选词期间按键误传播）、Markdown 目录大纲 Esc 关闭（src/client/md-toc.tsx:76）、Mermaid 图表弹窗缩放快捷键（src/client/mermaid.tsx:164）、上传遮罩 Esc 取消（src/client/UploadOverlay.tsx:33），均为正常 UI 交互功能，不采集按键内容；测试文件中的键盘监听同样为 IME 守卫测试，良性。
checked_items.en: The browser-side keyboard listeners (DSH-X05 hit) were reviewed: the IME input method composition guard (src/client/ime-guard.ts, capture phase prevents key propagation during IME selection), the Markdown table-of-contents Esc close (src/client/md-toc.tsx:76), the Mermaid chart popup zoom shortcut (src/client/mermaid.tsx:164), and the upload overlay Esc cancel (src/client/UploadOverlay.tsx:33) are all normal UI interaction features and do not collect key content. The keyboard listeners in test files are also IME guard tests; benign.

checked_items.zh: 机械规则命中项（DSH-X07，仓库内执行载体 .github/workflows/ci.yml 与 release.yml）经逐文件审查判定良性：CI 工作流仅运行构建、测试与挂载冒烟，发布工作流经 npm 官方可信发布（OIDC）发版并校验 tag，均在 GitHub 平台执行，不进入 dsh 宿主或用户机器运行面。
checked_items.en: The mechanical rule hits (DSH-X07, in-repo execution carriers .github/workflows/ci.yml and release.yml) were reviewed file by file and judged benign: the CI workflow only runs build, test, and patch smoke tests; the release workflow publishes via npm's official trusted publishing (OIDC) and validates tags. Both run on the GitHub platform and do not enter the dsh host or user machine execution surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了新增的 sidebar_open 工具：只验证路径/URL 合法性后通过 registry 推送到浏览器侧，不涉及子进程或动态执行。
checked_items.en: The new sidebar_open tool was checked: it only validates the path/URL and pushes it to the browser side via registry; it does not involve subprocesses or dynamic execution.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml:49 含一个 js 表达式（DSH-P01 命中），仅用于聚合包已挂载本插件时把本行置为禁用以防双挂载；表达式只读取加载器条目并返回布尔值，不执行外部载荷、不触达敏感面，判定为良性，无任意代码执行风险。
evidence.en: The patch configuration cordis.patch.yml:49 contains a js expression (DSH-P01 hit) used only to disable this line when the aggregate package already has this plugin mounted to prevent double-mounting. The expression only reads loader entries and returns a boolean; it does not execute external payloads or touch sensitive surfaces. Judged benign; no arbitrary code execution risk.

evidence.zh: 未发现对 cordis_define / cordis_run 等动态包工具的调用，无 node:vm 宿主执行面，不适用。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package tools such as cordis_define / cordis_run, and no node:vm host execution surface were found; not applicable.

evidence.zh: 安装钩子为标准的打包脚本（prepare 运行 tsdown），只编译本包源码；未发现下载即执行或隐蔽网络行为；仓库内的 CI 与发布工作流只在 GitHub 上运行，不在用户机器上执行，判定良性。
evidence.en: The install hook is a standard build script (prepare runs tsdown) that only compiles this package's source. No download-and-execute or hidden network behavior was found. The in-repo CI and release workflows run only on GitHub, not on user machines, and are judged benign.

evidence.zh: 包声明了 dsh.client 浏览器入口；对 client 半区专项检查键盘监听与剪贴板面：所有键盘监听均为 IME 守卫、弹窗快捷键等正常 UI 功能（IME 组合键守卫、Esc 关闭弹窗），未发现按键采集、剪贴板读取或凭据 RPC 调用。
evidence.en: The package declares a dsh.client browser entry. For the client half, keyboard listeners and clipboard surfaces were specifically checked: all keyboard listeners are normal UI features such as IME guards and dialog shortcuts (IME composition guard, Esc closes dialogs). No key capture, clipboard reads, or credential RPC calls were found.

evidence.zh: 未发现 subagents.registerProvider 调用，不适用。
evidence.en: No subagents.registerProvider call was found; not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未发现 jobs.start、schedule_create、goals 注册或 agent/turn-stopping 监听，插件仅通过宿主 jobs 路由读取作业状态（只读），不注册自己的持久化后台任务，不适用。
evidence.en: No jobs.start, schedule_create, goals registration, or agent/turn-stopping listeners were found. The plugin only reads job status through the host jobs route (read-only) and does not register its own persistent background tasks; not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 逐项核查了全部网络请求：页面端所有请求均为同源 /sidebar 路由（API、媒体、上传、WebSocket）；唯一的外部出站是侧边栏浏览器的 HTTP 头探测（browser.probe，src/index.ts:507-576），仅对目标站点做一次只读 HEAD/GET 请求获取响应头（X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors），限 http/https 非回环地址、8 秒超时、受信任围栏保护，不发送请求体数据。
checked_items.en: All network requests were checked individually: all page-side requests are same-origin /sidebar routes (API, media, upload, WebSocket). The only external outbound is the sidebar browser's HTTP header probe (browser.probe, src/index.ts:507-576), which performs a single read-only HEAD/GET request to the target site to obtain response headers (X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors), restricted to http/https non-loopback addresses, with an 8-second timeout and a trusted fence. No request body data is sent.

checked_items.zh: 机械规则命中项（DSH-C05，测试脚本与设计文档中的 curl）经核查判定良性：e2e 脚本中的 curl 仅对本机临时测试实例探活，设计文档中的 curl 引用仅为安全设计讨论，均非生产外发。
checked_items.en: The mechanical rule hit (DSH-C05, curl in test scripts and design documents) was reviewed and judged benign: the curl in e2e scripts only probes the local temporary test instance, and the curl references in design documents are only for security design discussions; none are production outbound calls.

checked_items.zh: 检查了新增的 browser.probe 功能：路由位于受信任围栏之后，只做 HTTP 头探测，不发送任何用户数据或会话数据到目标站点，判定良性。
checked_items.en: The new browser.probe feature was checked: the route is behind the trusted fence, only performs an HTTP header probe, and does not send any user data or session data to the target site. Judged benign.

checked_items.zh: 未发现读取敏感数据后编码外发、DNS 隧道、webhook 回调、AI 端点劫持等外泄模式；无新增出站域名。
checked_items.en: No exfiltration patterns such as encoding sensitive data and sending it out, DNS tunneling, webhook callbacks, or AI endpoint hijacking were found. No new outbound domains were added.

evidence.zh: 无凭据读取面，也无外发通道：页面全部请求同源、唯一外部出站是对目标站点的只读头探测（browser.probe）；测试脚本中的 curl 仅对本机临时实例，均不构成凭证外泄。
evidence.en: There is no credential-read surface and no exfiltration channel: all page requests are same-origin, the only external outbound is a read-only header probe to the target site (browser.probe); the curl in test scripts only targets the local temporary instance. None of these constitute credential exfiltration.

evidence.zh: 未发现 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件监听，未发现 registerAdapter 调用，不适用。
evidence.en: No agent/request or agent/request-error event listeners were found, and no registerAdapter calls were found; not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 核对包名、依赖与作者信息：无与官方或热门插件撞名的仿冒迹象；运行时依赖均为知名公开包，peer 依赖为 dsh 官方 SDK 版本范围，未发现抢注或混淆依赖。
checked_items.en: Package name, dependencies, and author information were verified: no impersonation signs matching official or popular plugin names. Runtime dependencies are all well-known public packages, and peer dependencies are version ranges of the official dsh SDK. No name squatting or dependency confusion was found.

checked_items.zh: 核查挂载配置是否触碰安全行或改写安全配置：patch 仅插入本插件一行并带禁用守卫（cordis.patch.yml:46-49），未改写沙箱、审批、权限配置，未修改注入/拦截配置，未用环境变量降权。
checked_items.en: The patch configuration was checked for touching security lines or rewriting security configuration: the patch only inserts this plugin's line with a disable guard (cordis.patch.yml:46-49), does not rewrite sandbox, approval, or permission configuration, does not modify injection/interception configuration, and does not use environment variables to downgrade privileges.

checked_items.zh: 与基线版本（v0.15.0）对比：manifest 声明（dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client）未新增，无能力升级；新增了 sidebar_open 模型工具（工具描述新增），但该工具功能与声明能力一致且无恶意行为，不作风险判定。
checked_items.en: Compared with baseline version (v0.15.0): the manifest declarations (dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client) have not been added, and there is no capability escalation. A new sidebar_open model tool was added (tool description added), but its functionality matches the declared capability and shows no malicious behavior; no risk finding is made.

checked_items.zh: 检查安装脚本对用户 profile 配置的修改：scripts/install.sh 和 install.ps1 会为 node-pty/protobufjs 预写构建许可、放行本包新版本并移除旧挂载行，均在安装本插件所需范围内且文档透明，未发现注入依赖或篡改他方配置。
checked_items.en: The install script's modification to the user profile configuration was checked: scripts/install.sh and install.ps1 pre-write build permissions for node-pty/protobufjs, allow new versions of this package, and remove old patch lines. All are within the scope needed to install this plugin and are transparent in documentation. No dependency injection or tampering with other parties' configuration was found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入本插件行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，未出现禁用安全行或以环境变量降权的写法。
evidence.en: The patch configuration only inserts this plugin's line and does not touch sandbox, approval, permission, or other security configurations. No syntax disabling security lines or downgrading privileges via environment variables was found.

evidence.zh: 未发现对工具执行前、审批请求等安全事件的高优先级监听或截断行为，不适用。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners or interception of tool pre-execution, approval requests, or other security events were found; not applicable.

evidence.zh: 与基线版本 v0.15.0 对比：manifest 声明无新增 dsh.bundle 或 dsh.client 声明，无升级自动激活风险。
evidence.en: Compared with baseline version v0.15.0: the manifest declarations have no new dsh.bundle or dsh.client additions, so there is no risk of automatic activation escalation.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入/拦截配置，不会给安全插件追加必需服务导致其永久等待。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not rewrite injection/interception configuration and will not append mandatory services to security plugins causing them to wait forever.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件是否自行启动服务或监听端口：插件复用宿主 webServer 注册路由（/sidebar/api、/sidebar/upload、/sidebar/file、/sidebar/html、/sidebar/bundle、/sidebar/ws/terminal 等），未自建监听；所有路由均叠加与宿主 /api 网关一致的浏览器信任围栏（src/trust-fence.ts，回环或受信主机 + Origin 校验），并明确标注该围栏是可达性策略而非认证层。
checked_items.en: It was verified whether the plugin starts its own service or listens on a port: the plugin reuses the host webServer to register routes (/sidebar/api, /sidebar/upload, /sidebar/file, /sidebar/html, /sidebar/bundle, /sidebar/ws/terminal, etc.) and does not create its own listener. All routes are layered with the same browser trusted fence as the host /api gateway (src/trust-fence.ts, loopback or trusted host plus Origin validation), and it is explicitly noted that this fence is an accessibility policy, not an authentication layer.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器与 HTML 预览默认启用 iframe 沙箱（不透明源、无同源权限、拒绝危险协议与回环地址），关闭沙箱为用户显式设置项且默认关闭；HTML 路由额外附加 CSP sandbox 指令作为纵深防御。
checked_items.en: The browser and HTML preview use an iframe sandbox by default (opaque origin, no same-origin permissions, dangerous protocols and loopback addresses blocked). Disabling the sandbox is a user-explicit setting and defaults to off. The HTML route additionally attaches a CSP sandbox directive as defense-in-depth.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证，运行时结论仅依据静态与语义分析。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed; runtime conclusions are based only on static and semantic analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口，仅复用宿主路由并叠加信任围栏；宿主 webserver 无认证层属 dsh 生态固有风险，不由本插件引入或扩大，不适用独立判定。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own web service or listen on a port; it only reuses host routes and layers a trusted fence. The host webserver's lack of an authentication layer is an inherent risk of the dsh ecosystem, not introduced or amplified by this plugin; no independent finding is applicable.

limits.en:
No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no l4-sandbox.json in the context directory; the platform did not provide dynamic probing artifacts), so runtime behavior conclusions are based only on static and semantic analysis.

The plugin declares dsh.bundle.patch (config-patch) and dsh.client (client-bundle) meta-capabilities; it provides terminal, Git, file read/write, sidebar browser, sidebar chat, and other capabilities, consistent with its declared business purpose.

All 32 mechanical rule hits were manually adjudicated one by one and are benign; no findings were produced.

Compared with the baseline version (v0.15.0), the new sidebar_open model tool and browser.probe route were added; both are consistent with declared capabilities and were reviewed to have no malicious behavior.
